parts.latex: Complete the network diagram by inserting the EST and LFT for each stage.
List the critical stages in the production of the machines.
What is the minimum time for production of the machines to be completed?
Which activity has the greatest float time?

solutions.latex: The critical stages are $A, B, D, G, H$.

Float $=$ LFT $-$ EST $-$ duration.

Stages $A, B, D, G, H$ are critical, so their float is $0$.

$$\begin{aligned} C &= 12-3-3 = 6 \\ E &= 19-7-6 = 6 \\ F &= 19-4-6 = 9 \end{aligned}$$

$\therefore$ activity $F$ has the greatest float time.

6393.stem:
The network diagram shows the nine steps needed to complete a project and the time (in minutes) needed for each step.

\exfigure{308_q33_1}

figures.cap: critical path network with blank scan boxes

parts.latex: Complete forward and backward scans on the diagram above and find the minimum time needed to complete the project.
What is the critical path for the project?
What is the float time of activity I?

solutions.latex:
Forward scan (earliest start time, left box): take the largest total along any path into each node.
$$\begin{aligned} \text{after } G &: 7 \\ \text{after } H &: 9 \\ \text{after } I,K &: \max(7+5,\ 9+8) = 17 \\ \text{after } M &: 17+6 = 23 \\ \text{end} &: \max(17+10,\ 23+7,\ 9+11,\ 9+13) = 30 \end{aligned}$$
Backward scan (latest start time, right box): start from the end time $30$ and take the smallest value.
$$\begin{aligned} \text{before } N &: 30-7 = 23 \\ \text{node after } I,K &: \min(30-10,\ 23-6) = 17 \\ \text{node after } H &: \min(17-8,\ 30-11,\ 30-13) = 9 \\ \text{node after } G &: 17-5 = 12 \\ \text{start} &: \min(12-7,\ 9-9) = 0 \end{aligned}$$
\exfigure{308_q33_s1}
$$\therefore\ \text{minimum completion time} = 30 \text{ minutes}$$
criteria: Completes the forward scan correctly, or equivalent merit

meta.self_check: Forward/backward scans recomputed; start node backward value 0 equals forward value 0.
meta.generated_note: Assumes the left box is the earliest start time and the right box the latest start time.

solutions.latex:
The critical path joins the nodes where the earliest and latest start times are equal.

These are the activities with no float: $H$, $K$, $M$, $N$.

Check: $9+8+6+7 = 30$.
$$\therefore\ \text{critical path: } H \to K \to M \to N$$

meta.generated_note: The arrows are in the path label only as notation for the order of activities.

solutions.latex:
Activity $I$ runs from the node after $G$ to the node after $I,K$.

Float time $=$ latest finish $-$ earliest start $-$ duration.
$$\begin{aligned} \text{float} &= 17 - 7 - 5 \\ &= 5 \text{ minutes} \end{aligned}$$
$$\therefore\ \text{the float time of } I \text{ is } 5 \text{ minutes}$$

meta.self_check: Alternative: latest start of node after G is 12, minus earliest 7 = 5.
